errors.text_span: След това линията намалява до стойност около -0,80% в края на 2009 г.
errors.evidence: The value in 2009 is positive, approximately +0.8%, not negative (-0.80%) as stated.

errors.text_span: след което показва плавна, постепенно покачваща се тенденция до приблизително 2,40% в края на 2011 г.
errors.evidence: This description is incorrect in two ways: 1) The trend is not a smooth rise; the line rises from 2009 to 2010 and then stays flat between 2010 and 2011. 2) The value at the end of 2011 is approximately 1.8%, not 2.40%.

errors.text_span: достигайки най-ниската си точка от около -0,50% в края на 2014 г.
errors.evidence: The lowest point on the graph is reached in the year 2015, not 2014. The value in 2014 is positive, around +0.2%.

errors.text_span: и след това се покачва до приблизително 1,80% в края на 2019 г.
errors.evidence: The description of the final trend is incorrect. The line does not rise to its final point in 2019; it peaks in 2018 at approximately 1.7% and then decreases to approximately 1.6% in 2019. The stated final value of 1.80% is also incorrect.
